payload.core_mechanism_summary: Sort waste cell positions by recalculated 1D index; for each query, count preceding waste cells by scanning sorted list; compute crop via (total_prior_nonwaste) % 3.
payload.rationale: The solution maps 2D coordinates to a 1D index, sorts those indices to facilitate counting preceding waste cells for each query. This is a typical custom key sorting approach to ordering multi-dimensional data.
